clips.title: The story
paras: Skyseer the Elder is an honored ancestral spirit residing atop Freewind Post during the Lunar Festival. Travelers seek out his presence high above Thousand Needles to pay their respects to the ancestors and receive his ancient blessing.

Perched upon the lofty wooden bluffs of Freewind Post, Elder Skyseer appears bathed in a radiant pillar of celestial light. Positioned near the bridges leading toward the massive mechanical lifts, his ghostly presence offers a quiet sanctuary amid the windswept mesas of Thousand Needles.

Elder Skyseer receives visiting adventurers who come to honor the past during the celebration of the Lunar Festival. Beyond acknowledging their homage, the venerable elder can guide travelers toward his kin scattered across Kalimdor, including Elder Morningdew and Elder Runetotem.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
